Hi Lena / Raj —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our call, I wanted to start the MAP kickoff thread so we have one canonical place for owners, timelines, and the benchmark plan. Goal: get to a scoped POC (30k tokens/day, inference latency SLO <= 200ms p50) and a go/no-go decision within 6 weeks so your product team can plan the Q4 rollout.

Attached is a first-pass MAP and a short benchmark doc that outlines the evaluation buckets we recommend (prompt stability, hallucination rate, latency/cost). Please review and tell me who will own each item on your side.

Proposed Redwood owners:
- Dylan Brooks — AE, overall program lead and procurement / commercial questions
- Tessa Morgan — CSM, rollout/enablement and success criteria tracking
- Marcus Lin — Solutions Engineer, benchmark design and prompt instrumentation

Requested BioMedix owners (suggested):
- Evaluation lead / prompts owner
- Security/compliance contact (for SOC2 / data handling questions)
- Product PM for acceptance criteria and user-acceptance testing (UAT)

Immediate asks:
1) Please confirm (by EOD Thu) the BioMedix owners and any must-have success metrics beyond what’s in the attached MAP.
2) If the proposed 6-week close timeline is aggressive, flag now — we can extend but would like to be explicit.

I’ll slot a 30–45 minute kickoff next week once owners are confirmed.

Thanks —
Dylan

Success metrics we care about (in addition to your list):

- Cost per 1k tokens below our current baseline (we’ll share the exact number in the MAP)

Timeline: 6 weeks sounds reasonable but we need a hard freeze on model changes during the evaluation window (no architecture swaps mid-POC). We’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff next Tue (Oct 5) morning EST — Raj, Priya, and Maria should be there.

Lena

Great — quick technical clarifications / suggestions from my side:

1) Benchmarks: I suggest we split the evaluation into three lanes so we have clear owners and automations:
   - Prompt correctness (Raj) — run 500 curated prompts, automated labeling + spot manual review
   - Regression and stability (Marcus) — daily regression suite against the seed model and guardrails for prompt drift
   - Performance profile (Redwood ops) — end-to-end P50/P95 latency with the KV cache enabled and with cold-start scenarios

2) Instrumentation: I’ll provide a small harness (script + Docker) to collect latency/cost per request, and a prompt tagging schema so we can track categories (clinical, billing, triage).

3) Owners: can we make Raj the single owner for prompts (BioMedix) and me the owner for the regression infra (Redwood)? That will simplify handoffs.

I’ll drop a short README into the Drive folder today and attach a stubbed benchmark run plan (will upload by EOD).

—Marcus
